about_the_game:
Composed by Michael Cosio, the creator of Flesh Made Fear, this 19-track soundtrack captures the full range of the nightmare — from quiet dread to full-blown panic.

Every piece was written and produced during the game’s development, shaping its mood and bleeding directly into its world. Expect haunting synths, distorted textures, and unsettling melodies that blur the line between fear and fascination.

Whether you’ve survived the horrors or just want to revisit their atmosphere, this soundtrack offers a dark, immersive journey through the heart of Flesh Made Fear.
